lua: T = require('lib.testkit'); S = require('lib.state'); CAM = require('lib.camera'); FOLLOW = nil; LOOK = function(lx, ly, lz, ty, fov, tz) local v = nova.named('van'); local s, c = math.sin(v.heading), math.cos(v.heading); local g = nova.terrain_height(v.x, v.z); tz = tz or 0; CAM.pinned = { v.x + s * lz + c * lx, g + ly, v.z + c * lz - s * lx, v.x + s * tz, g + (ty or 0.9), v.z + c * tz, fov or 40 } end; PARK = function(x, z, h) local v = nova.named('van'); v.autopilot = nil; v.driven = false; v.engine_on = false; v:teleport(x, z, h); nova.scene_now().mode = 'foot'; nova.named('postmaster').seated = false end; SIT = function() local s = nova.scene_now(); s.mode = 'van'; local v = nova.named('van'); v.driven = true; v.engine_on = true; nova.named('postmaster').seated = true end; BESIDE = function(dx, dy, dz, fov) local p = nova.named('postmaster'); local g = nova.terrain_height(p.x, p.z) + (p.y or 0); CAM.pinned = { p.x + dx, g + dy, p.z + dz, p.x, g + 0.45, p.z, fov or 30 } end; BEHIND = function(d, h, fov, front) local p = nova.named('postmaster'); local s, c = math.sin(p.face), math.cos(p.face); local k = front and 1 or -1; local g = nova.terrain_height(p.x, p.z) + (p.y or 0); CAM.pinned = { p.x + s * d * k, g + h, p.z + c * d * k, p.x, g + 0.45, p.z, fov or 30 } end; START = function(x, z, f) local p = nova.named('postmaster'); PARK(13.5, -170.5, 0.3); p.x, p.z, p.face, p.speed = x, z, f, 0; S.carrying = nil; CAM.reset(f) end

route.lua: START(4.5, -128, 0); FOLLOW = function() BEHIND(4.6, 1.3, 30, true) end

route.capture: running, turning right, from the front
running, turning left, from the front
walking, turning right: no bank, arms down

route.lua: START(4.5, -128, 0); S.carrying = 'hazel'; FOLLOW = function() BEHIND(4.6, 1.3, 30) end

route.capture: trotting with a parcel, turning right (half the bank)
trotting with a parcel, turning left, from the front

route.lua: FOLLOW = nil; CAM.pinned = nil; S.carrying = nil; PARK(13.5, -170.5, 0.3); SIT(); CAM.reset(0.3); T.drive('hazel')

route.capture: handbrake in the bend: brake lamps, the tail stepping out

record: (function() local v = nova.named('van'); local sh, ch = math.sin(v.heading), math.cos(v.heading); return string.format('%.1f %.2f %.2f %.1f %s %s', v.speed, v.steer, v.yaw_rate or 0, math.deg(math.atan(v.velx * ch - v.velz * sh, math.abs(v.velx * sh + v.velz * ch) + 1e-6)), tostring(v.handbrake), v.surface) end)()
